clips.title: The story
paras: Witchwing harpies strike supply caravans on the northwestern trails of the Barrens. Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads sends you to hunt their raiders and roguefeathers, taking their talons as proof.

Witchwing harpies strike caravans crossing the Barrens. From rocky crags in the northwest, they swoop on merchant trains and supply wagons. They kill pack animals and seize goods bound for orcish outposts, making each journey through the region dangerous.

Darsok Swiftdagger, an orc rogue, has spent days watching the flock's habits and ranks. He believes an unfocused assault on their mountain roosts would scatter them. His plan is to break the Witchwing from the lowest rank upward, starting with the raiders before turning to their commanders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The blasted harpies have been ravaging our caravan supplies for too long. It's time we slit a few of their throats and diminished their numbers.
I've been snooping around their nests and figured out who leads who. The most devastating attack will destroy a good section of their lower chain of command and then we can work our way to the top.
I'll start you off slow, take out Witchwing Harpies and Witchwing Roguefeathers in the Northwest and bring me 8 Witchwing talons. That should be a good start...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Cut up enough of them yet? Keep slicing and taking trophies. I want 8 Witchwing talons.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, these are nice. Real nice... Good job, friend. I look forward to seeing more of your work in the future.
